question: Should we go live?
title: Northstar Release R12
summary: Tests technical, operational, commercial and authority evidence before a customer-facing release decision.
detail: Fourteen sources were mapped, all ten seeded contradictions were detected and nine readiness rules required action before unconditional approval could be supported.

question: Is our programme really on track?
title: Delivery confidence beyond status reporting
summary: Tests whether reported progress is supported by commitments, dependencies, evidence and a plausible route to completion.
detail: The case will distinguish dashboard status from delivery reality and explore causal relationships, forecast confidence and the evidence behind a recovery intervention.

question: Will this programme deliver the benefits we wanted?
title: Benefits intelligence
summary: Connects the original business case, benefit measures, approved changes, current delivery and today's organisational need.
detail: The case will test whether benefits remain relevant, achievable and measurable after scope, actors, assumptions and the operating environment have changed.

question: Should we approve this change?
title: Strategic drift and trajectory
summary: Explores whether an apparently sensible change moves the programme away from the trajectory that supported the original benefits case.
detail: The intended case will connect original purpose, benefits, current scope, authorised changes, changing actors and today's organisational need. The 72% figure is illustrative, not a result from the Northstar POC.
